ucs.title: [LLM] Turla ComRAT v4 Gmail web-interface C2 (non-browser process talks to mail.google.com)
ucs.description: Hunts Turla's signature ComRAT v4 / Agent.BTZ mail-channel C2, which embeds an IE/COM rendering engine inside a custom binary to drive the Gmail web UI (read inbox, parse attachments for commands, send results back as drafts). Detection fires when a process that is not a sanctioned browser or mail client emits HTTPS to Gmail surfaces.
ucs.splunk: | tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Web.url) as url values(Web.http_user_agent) as user_agent values(Web.action) as action values(Web.bytes_in) as bytes_in values(Web.bytes_out) as bytes_out FROM datamodel=Web WHERE (Web.url="*mail.google.com*" OR Web.url="*mail-attachment.googleusercontent.com*" OR Web.url="*accounts.google.com*" OR Web.url="*googleusercontent.com*/mail*") AND NOT (Web.app IN ("chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","iexplore.exe","brave.exe","opera.exe","vivaldi.exe","safari.exe","outlook.exe","thunderbird.exe","olk.exe","msteams.exe","teams.exe")) BY Web.src Web.user Web.app Web.dest | `drop_dm_object_name("Web")` | where NOT match(user_agent, "(?i)(Chrome\/|Firefox\/|Edg\/|Edge\/|Safari\/|Mozilla\/5\.0|Outlook\/|Thunderbird\/)") | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)` | sort - count
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let GmailHosts = dynamic(["mail.google.com","mail-attachment.googleusercontent.com","accounts.google.com","googleusercontent.com"]);
let Browsers = dynamic(["chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","iexplore.exe","brave.exe","opera.exe","vivaldi.exe","safari.exe"]);
let MailClients = dynamic(["outlook.exe","olk.exe","thunderbird.exe","msteams.exe","teams.exe","hxoutlook.exe","hxtsr.exe"]);
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where RemoteIPType == "Public"
| where isnotempty(RemoteUrl)
| where RemoteUrl has_any (GmailHosts)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ (Browsers)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ (MailClients)
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
// Turla loaders frequently run from %ProgramData%, %AppData%, %Temp%, or alongside a fake service host
| extend SuspectPath = iff(InitiatingProcessFolderPath has_any (@"\ProgramData\", @"\AppData\", @"\Users\Public\", @"\Temp\", @"\Windows\Temp\"), "yes", "no")
| summarize EventCount = count(),
            FirstSeen = min(Timestamp), LastSeen = max(Timestamp),
            Hosts = make_set(RemoteUrl, 25),
            SampleCmd = any(InitiatingProcessCommandLine)
            by DeviceName, AccountName = InitiatingProcessAccountName,
               InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
               InitiatingProcessSHA256, SuspectPath
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let GmailHosts = dynamic(["mail.google.com","mail-attachment.googleusercontent.com","accounts.google.com","googleusercontent.com"]);
ImWebSession
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where DstHostname has_any (GmailHosts) or HttpHostName has_any (GmailHosts) or Url has_any (GmailHosts)
| where isempty(HttpRequestHeaderUserAgent)
   or not(HttpRequestHeaderUserAgent has_any ("Chrome/","Firefox/","Edg/","Edge/","Safari/","Mozilla/5.0","Outlook/","Thunderbird/"))
| where isnotempty(SrcHostname)
| where SrcUsername !endswith "$"
| summarize EventCount = count(),
            FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated),
            UAs = make_set(HttpRequestHeaderUserAgent, 10),
            Hosts = make_set(DstHostname, 10),
            Urls = make_set(Url, 25)
            by SrcHostname, SrcUsername, SrcIpAddr
| order by FirstSeen desc

title: Turla ComRAT v4 Gmail Web Interface C2
id: 9b9a9e2c-1d2b-4f6e-9a2b-1c0a1d2b3c4d
status: experimental
description: Detects non-browser, non-mail-client processes initiating outbound HTTPS to Gmail web endpoints, indicative of Turla ComRAT v4 (Agent.BTZ successor) mail-channel C2.
references:
  - https://www.welivesecurity.com/2020/05/26/agentbtz-comratv4-ten-year-journey/
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0010/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/21
tags:

  - attack.t1071.003
  - attack.t1102.002
  - attack.g0010
logsource:
  category: network_connection
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_dst:
    DestinationHostname|contains:
      - 'mail.google.com'
      - 'mail-attachment.googleusercontent.com'
      - 'accounts.google.com'
      - 'googleusercontent.com'
  filter_browsers:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\chrome.exe'
      - '\msedge.exe'
      - '\firefox.exe'
      - '\iexplore.exe'
      - '\brave.exe'
      - '\opera.exe'
      - '\vivaldi.exe'
      - '\safari.exe'
  filter_mail_clients:
    Image|endswith:

      - '\olk.exe'

      - '\msteams.exe'
      - '\hxoutlook.exe'
  condition: selection_dst and not (filter_browsers or filter_mail_clients)
falsepositives:
  - Custom backup or productivity tools using Gmail IMAP/HTTPS bridges
  - Power-user automation (gam.exe, gyb.exe) - allowlist by SHA256
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:3 (@DestinationHostname:*mail.google.com* OR @DestinationHostname:*Mail.Google.Com* OR @DestinationHostname:*googleusercontent.com* OR @DestinationHostname:*GoogleUserContent.com* OR @DestinationHostname:*accounts.google.com*) -@Image:(*\chrome.exe OR *\Chrome.exe OR *\CHROME.EXE OR *\msedge.exe OR *\MsEdge.exe OR *\MSEDGE.EXE OR *\firefox.exe OR *\Firefox.exe OR *\brave.exe OR *\Brave.exe OR *\iexplore.exe OR *\IExplore.exe OR *\opera.exe OR *\vivaldi.exe OR *\safari.exe OR *\outlook.exe OR *\Outlook.exe OR *\OUTLOOK.EXE OR *\olk.exe OR *\thunderbird.exe OR *\teams.exe OR *\msteams.exe OR *\hxoutlook.exe)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=DnsRequest DomainName=/(^|\.)((mail\.google\.com)|(mail-attachment\.googleusercontent\.com)|(accounts\.google\.com)|(googleusercontent\.com))$/i
| NOT (ContextImageFileName=/\\(chrome|msedge|firefox|brave|iexplore|opera|vivaldi|safari|outlook|olk|thunderbird|teams|msteams|hxoutlook)\.exe$/i)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ContextImageFileName, UserName], function={ count(as=requests) | count(field=DomainName, distinct=true, as=distinct_gmail_hosts) | min(@timestamp, as=first_seen) | max(@timestamp, as=last_seen) })
| requests >= 3

ucs.title: [LLM] Turla LightNeuron Exchange Transport Agent registration (TransportAgents registry write + non-Microsoft DLL load by MSExchangeTransport)
ucs.description: Hunts Turla's LightNeuron backdoor — a Microsoft Exchange Server Transport Agent that registers under HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\ExchangeServer\v15\Transport\Agents, is loaded into the MSExchangeTransport.exe process, and intercepts/exfiltrates every email passing through the MTA. Fires on (a) registry writes under the TransportAgents key, and (b) MSExchangeTransport.exe loading a DLL from outside trusted Exchange/Microsoft paths.
ucs.splunk: | tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Registry.registry_value_name) as value_name values(Registry.registry_value_data) as value_data values(Registry.process_name) as process_name values(Registry.user) as user FROM datamodel=Endpoint.Registry WHERE Registry.registry_path="*\\Microsoft\\ExchangeServer\\v15\\Transport\\Agents*" AND Registry.action IN ("created","modified","set") BY Registry.dest Registry.registry_path Registry.registry_key_name | `drop_dm_object_name("Registry")` | where NOT (match(process_name, "(?i)(ServiceControl|UpdateExchangeServer|setup|update)\\.exe$")) | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)` | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 30d;
let TrustedExchangePaths = dynamic([
    @"c:\program files\microsoft\exchange server\",
    @"c:\windows\microsoft.net\",
    @"c:\windows\winsxs\",
    @"c:\windows\system32\",
    @"c:\windows\syswow64\",
    @"c:\windows\assembly\",
    @"c:\program files\common files\microsoft shared\",
    @"c:\program files (x86)\common files\microsoft shared\"
]);
let RegistryHits =
    DeviceRegistryEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where RegistryKey has @"\Microsoft\ExchangeServer\v15\Transport\Agents"
    | where ActionType in ("RegistryKeyCreated","RegistryValueSet")
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("servicecontrol.exe","updateexchangeserver.exe","setup.exe","update.exe","msiexec.exe")
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName, Signal="TransportAgentRegistryWrite",
              RegistryKey, RegistryValueName, RegistryValueData,
              InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              InitiatingProcessAccountName, InitiatingProcessSHA256;
let DllHits =
    DeviceImageLoadEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "MSExchangeTransport.exe"
    | extend Lower = tolower(FolderPath)
    | where not(Lower has_any (TrustedExchangePaths))
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName, Signal="NonTrustedDllLoadedByExchangeTransport",
              RegistryKey="", RegistryValueName=FileName, RegistryValueData=FolderPath,
              InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine="",
              InitiatingProcessAccountName="", InitiatingProcessSHA256=SHA256;
union RegistryHits, DllHits
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 30d;
ImRegistryEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where RegistryKey has @"\Microsoft\ExchangeServer\v15\Transport\Agents"
| where EventType in ("RegistryKeyCreated","RegistryValueSet","Set","Create")
| where ActingProcessName !in~ ("servicecontrol.exe","updateexchangeserver.exe","setup.exe","update.exe","msiexec.exe")
| project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, EventType,
          RegistryKey, RegistryValue, RegistryValueData,
          ActingProcessName, ActingProcessCommandLine, ActorUsername
| order by TimeGenerated desc

id: 7d4f1c2a-8b3e-4a91-9f4c-2a1b2c3d4e5f
status: experimental
description: Detects writes to the Microsoft Exchange Transport Agents registry key, the persistence anchor used by Turla's LightNeuron backdoor to hook every email passing through MSExchangeTransport.exe.
references:
  - https://www.welivesecurity.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/05/ESET-LightNeuron.pdf
  - https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0395/
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0010/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/21
tags:
  - attack.persistence
  - attack.t1505.003
  - attack.t1546
  - attack.t1112
  - attack.g0010
logsource:
  category: registry_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    TargetObject|contains: '\Microsoft\ExchangeServer\v15\Transport\Agents'
    EventType:
      - 'SetValue'
      - 'CreateKey'
  filter_legit_admin:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\ServiceControl.exe'
      - '\UpdateExchangeServer.exe'
      - '\setup.exe'
      - '\msiexec.exe'
  condition: selection and not filter_legit_admin
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate third-party transport agents (anti-spam, journaling, DLP) installed by Exchange admins
  - Cumulative Update installation
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:13 (@TargetObject:*\\Microsoft\\ExchangeServer\\v15\\Transport\\Agents* OR @TargetObject:*\\microsoft\\exchangeserver\\v15\\transport\\agents* OR @TargetObject:*\\MICROSOFT\\EXCHANGESERVER\\v15\\TRANSPORT\\AGENTS*) -@Image:(*\ServiceControl.exe OR *\servicecontrol.exe OR *\UpdateExchangeServer.exe OR *\updateexchangeserver.exe OR *\setup.exe OR *\Setup.exe OR *\msiexec.exe OR *\MsiExec.exe)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=AsepValueUpdate RegObjectName=/\\Microsoft\\ExchangeServer\\v15\\Transport\\Agents/i
| NOT (ContextImageFileName=/\\(ServiceControl|UpdateExchangeServer|setup|msiexec)\.exe$/i)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, RegObjectName, RegValueName, RegStringValue, ContextImageFileName, UserName], function={ count(as=writes) | min(@timestamp, as=first_seen) | max(@timestamp, as=last_seen) })
| sort(first_seen, order=desc)
